page.overview:
Who is Karl Grimm?

Karl Grimm was a Temerian miner and member of the Grimm family.

After receiving funding from the Hogge sisters to capitalise on a copper mine, Karl, and his sons Kurt and Kopek, constructed the venture at the future site of Grimmwald, the town he built from the ore's profits. Fortifying an impressive wealth, the veins eventually ran dry, and Karl realised he had lost nearly everything, his life too. He left his two sons a mountain of debt, but before he died, he started selling off his assets, trying to facilitate and maintain his lavish life for its brief remainder.
